author: massicomar
title: Grid Paths
summary:
Consider an $n \times n$ grid whose squares may have traps. It is not allowed to move to a square with a trap.

Your task is to calculate the number of paths from the upper-left square to the lower-right square. You can only move right or down.

Input

The first input line has an integer $n$: the size of the grid.

After this, there are $n$ lines that describe the grid. Each line has $n$ characters: . denotes an empty cell, and * denotes a trap.

Output

Print the number of paths modulo $10^9+7$.

constraints.text: n ≤ 1000 (n × n grid), traps, moves right/down only

explanation: Paths to a cell come from the cell above or the cell to the left; trap cells hold 0.
traps: If the start cell is a trap, the answer is 0.

extraLayers.prompt: What should the DP state represent?

options.text: dp[i][j] = number of paths from (1,1) to (i,j) avoiding traps

options.why: Every right/down path has the same length; you need a count.

options.text: dp[k] = number of paths of length k
options.why: All paths have length 2n−2; the cell matters, not the length.

options.text: dp[i] = number of paths reaching row i
options.why: Loses the column, which decides where traps are.

extraLayers.explanation: Each cell is a subproblem: how many ways can you get here?

extraLayers.prompt: Given that state, which transition is right?

options.why: That maximizes length; you need a count.

extraLayers.explanation: The last move into (i,j) was either down from above or right from the left.

es.explanation: Los caminos a una celda vienen de la celda de arriba o de la de la izquierda; las celdas con trampa valen 0.
traps: Si la celda de inicio es una trampa, la respuesta es 0.

dp-state.explanation: Cada celda es un subproblema: ¿de cuántas formas se puede llegar acá?

why.b: Todos los caminos de derecha/abajo tienen el mismo largo; necesitas una cantidad.
why.c: Todos los caminos tienen largo 2n−2; importa la celda, no el largo.
why.d: Pierde la columna, que decide dónde están las trampas.

dp-transition.explanation: El último movimiento hacia (i,j) fue hacia abajo desde arriba o hacia la derecha desde la izquierda.

why.b: Eso maximiza el largo; necesitas una cantidad.
why.d: No se permiten movimientos en diagonal.
